description: This Java class implements an ECU initialization data handler for the RomRaider project. It represents an ECU initialization message, extracts ECU ID from a byte array, and provides accessors for the data.

classes.name: SSMEcuInit
classes.description: Represents an ECU initialization message, extracting ECU ID from byte array and providing access to ID and raw bytes.

methods.name: SSMEcuInit
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with ECU init bytes and extracts the ECU ID.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the extracted ECU ID as a string.

methods.name: getEcuInitBytes
methods.description: Returns the raw ECU initialization bytes.
